description: Integer beyond 2^53-1 documents Node/Java numeric limitations

limitations.node: Node single number resolver and Java default Long-via-double path cannot losslessly represent integers beyond 2^53-1; Fireweave documents int reliability within Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER cross-language.
